name: invite
description: A cute, modern digital date invitation with a private response dashboard.

scripts.setup:local: docker compose up -d --wait && npm run db:push && npm --workspace server run generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build: npm --workspace client run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm --workspace server run start
